Package org.geysermc.paletter.block

Class RegisteredBlockState

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.block.RegisteredBlockState
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.definitions.BlockDefinition, org.cloudburstmc.protocol.common.Definition
public final class RegisteredBlockState extends Object implements org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.definitions.BlockDefinition
A block state definition in a compiled palette: the runtime id of a state. Instances are unique per palette and compared by identity, so == between definitions from the same palette is safe.

In BlockNetworkIds.HASHED palettes, vanilla states are additionally shared between all palettes of a Paletter, across versions: equal state, same instance. That is why a state does not know its block, the state set of a block can differ between versions. Ask the palette you have the state from, BlockRegistry.block(RegisteredBlockState), for its RegisteredBlock, which also has the effective components and properties of a state. The position of a state in its palette is BlockRegistry.indexOf(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.definitions.BlockDefinition).

Since:
1.0.0
